note: wrong_sense probe: pick up->pick. Lemma 'pick' (dim_vocabulary 14559; 2 senses: select/choose, harvest). The arm is meant to lift; bare 'pick' selects the choose sense.
reference: The coding is important. You write instructions for the Arduino. You can make the arm pick up small things. You can move them to a new spot.
reproduction: The coding is important. You write instructions for the Arduino. You can make the arm pick small things. You can move them to a new spot.

note: wrong_sense probe: 'is like' (prep, similar to) -> 'likes' (verb, enjoy). Lemma 'like' (dim_vocabulary 15338; 4 senses incl. enjoy and similar-to).
reference: One motor can make the arm go up and down. Another motor can make it move left and right. A third motor can open and close a gripper. This is like a hand.
reproduction: One motor can make the arm go up and down. Another motor can make it move left and right. A third motor can open and close a gripper. This likes a hand.
